component.name: GtkHx
component.summary: Hotline client for chat and file sharing

description.p: GtkHx is a client for the Hotline protocol, the late-1990s chat-and-file-sharing system that predated modern messaging apps. It connects to Hotline 1.2, 1.5, 1.8, and 1.9 servers, including the post-original mhxd fork that's still active today.

ul.li: Public chat with formatted text and color-coded users
Private messages and private chat rooms
Voice chat, video chat and screen sharing, on servers that support them
Connections to several servers at once, each in its own tab
News (1.0 flat-file and 1.5+ threaded categories)
A two-panel file browser, with downloads, uploads, and previews
Tracker browsing for finding active servers
Saved connections, each with its own nickname and icon if you like
TLS with fingerprint pinning, and HOPE secure login with Blowfish or ChaCha20-Poly1305 link encryption

description.p: GtkHx was originally written in 2000 against GTK+ 1.2 and has been ported forward to GTK 4 with libadwaita styling. Wire compatibility with original Hotline servers is preserved.

screenshot.caption: The main toolbar and chat window
Browsing files on a Hotline server

description.p: Video chat and screen sharing, a slimmer main window, and a new file browser.

ul.li: Video chat and screen sharing on servers that support the video extension, in a new dockable Video panel
The file browser is its own window, one per connection, with labeled transfer buttons and a right-click menu
Slimmer window chrome: the banner and connection status move into the header bar, the status bar is gone, and the toolbar is optional
Each pane has compact controls of its own, and pane titles and action bars can be hidden
Flatpak builds work offline again
Fixed the Flatpak's bundled library paths
News: fixed a double load, and creating a new folder
The macOS and Windows packages bundle their fonts and translations
More built-in servers for new users
Fixed chat not scrolling to the bottom after a multi-line message

description.p: Multiple connections, a rewritten chat view, and macOS and Windows builds.

ul.li: Connect to several servers at once and switch between them with tabs
Bookmarks become Settings → Connections, each able to override your nickname and icon
A new chat view: faster, with Markdown, speaker icons and grouping, and search with Ctrl+F
Settings and connections are now stored as TOML, migrated from the old files
GtkHx is now available for macOS and Windows
Fixed resuming file transfers
Japanese translation, and updated translations
